profile.label: M.Sc. Computer Science (Padova) — toward pure mathematics & generative models
profile.summary: Mathematics-minded researcher, currently an M.Sc. Computer Science student at the University of Padova, working at the meeting point of pure mathematics and generative modeling — optimal transport, differential geometry, functional analysis, and the geometry of stochastic differential equations.

items.title: M.Sc. in Computer Science
details: Focusing coursework and projects toward mathematics — optimal transport, generative models, and the analysis of stochastic dynamics.
Deep-learning challenge work on optimal-transport flow matching (see Projects).

items.title: B.Sc. in Computer Engineering

Undergraduate focus on statistical inference and generative modeling.

items.title: Optimal-transport flow matching for traffic forecasting

items.title: Generative models for time-series data

Diffusion-based meta-learning for retail forecasting (submitted to EJOR).
